karty.priklad: Noson agored y clwb celf a chrefft.
karty.priklad_cs: Open evening of the arts and crafts club (crefft → [ch]refft after a).

extra.pozn: agored = open (a door, a person, an event); a shop is "ar agor" (open) / "ar gau" (closed); sentence from the events calendar, p. 221

karty.priklad: Mae pobl yn dod i Gymru i ymweld â lleoedd diddorol neu hanesyddol.
karty.priklad_cs: People come to Wales to visit interesting or historic places (Cymru → [G]ymru after i).

extra.pozn: h- doesn't take soft mutation; hanesydd = historian (outside the coursebook); lleoedd = places, colloquially in the south rather llefydd; sentence based on Siaradwch, p. 216

karty.cs: on the whole, all in all
karty.priklad: Ar y cyfan, roedd y gwyliau'n dda iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: On the whole, the holiday was very good (da → [dd]a after 'n).

karty.priklad: Ces i fy ngeni ar y nawfed ar hugain o Chwefror, felly dim ond bob blwyddyn naid mae fy mhen-blwydd i.
karty.priklad_cs: I was born on the twenty-ninth of February, so I only have a birthday every leap year (geni → [ng]eni, pen-blwydd → [mh]en-blwydd after fy; pob → [b]ob as an adverb of time).
karty.mnemo: naid = leap: the year that leaps an extra day – a leap over a roaring bonfire on 29 February.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; feminine because of blwyddyn; naid = leap, jump, neidio = to jump (L2); the book gives no plural; in the book: y diwrnod arbennig mewn blwyddyn naid, p. 218; own example

sever.priklad: Ges i fy ngeni ar y nawfed ar hugain o Chwefror, felly dim ond bob blwyddyn naid mae fy mhen-blwydd i.
sever.priklad_cs: I was born on the twenty-ninth of February, so I only have a birthday every leap year (geni → [ng]eni, pen-blwydd → [mh]en-blwydd after fy; pob → [b]ob as an adverb of time).
sever.pozn: north: ges i instead of ces i (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Dewch i ddathlu Calan Mai yn y ffordd draddodiadol.
karty.priklad_cs: Come and celebrate May Day the traditional way (dathlu → [dd]athlu after i; traddodiadol → [d]raddodiadol after the feminine ffordd).
karty.mnemo: Calan = first day of the month (Latin kalendae): the CALendar starts with Calan.

extra.pozn: Calan = first day: Calan Gaeaf = 1 November, its eve Nos Galan Gaeaf (31 Oct) corresponds to Halloween (p. 221); dydd Calan = New Year's Day, nos Galan = New Year's Eve (p. 218); sentence from the events calendar, p. 220

karty.priklad: Chi fydd yn penderfynu trwy guro dwylo.
karty.priklad_cs: You will decide by clapping (curo → [g]uro after trwy).
karty.mnemo: curo (to beat, L9) + dwylo (hands): to beat your hands together.

extra.pozn: curo = to knock, to beat (L9); dwylo = both hands (dual of llaw); emphatic sentence with fydd (L13); sentence from the events calendar, p. 220

karty.priklad: Dewch i gefnogi Cylch Chwarae'r Bryn.
karty.priklad_cs: Come and support the Bryn Playgroup (cefnogi → [g]efnogi after i).
karty.mnemo: cylch (circle) + chwarae (play): a circle of toddlers round a play mat.

extra.pozn: in the Geirfa in the box arall; masculine because of cylch; plural cylchoedd chwarae (outside the coursebook); sentence from the events calendar, p. 221

karty.priklad: Ar Ddydd Ffolant, ces i gerdyn gan rywun dirgel.
karty.priklad_cs: On Valentine's Day I got a card from a secret admirer (dydd → [dd]ydd after ar; cerdyn → [g]erdyn as the object; rhywun → [r]ywun after gan).

extra.pozn: dydd San Ffolant (p. 218) = the same; the Welsh lovers' day is Santes Dwynwen, 25 January (p. 220); own example

sever.priklad: Ar Ddydd Ffolant, ges i gerdyn gan rywun dirgel.
sever.priklad_cs: On Valentine's Day I got a card from a secret admirer (dydd → [dd]ydd after ar; cerdyn → [g]erdyn as the object; rhywun → [r]ywun after gan).
sever.pozn: north: ges i instead of ces i (outside the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Roedd hi'n bwrw glaw. Eto i gyd, aethon ni am dro.
karty.priklad_cs: It was raining. Even so, we went for a walk (tro → [d]ro after am).
karty.mnemo: eto (yet, again) + i gyd (all): "and yet, with all that".

karty.priklad: Cafodd y castell ei adeiladu yn yr Oesoedd Canol.
karty.priklad_cs: The castle was built in the Middle Ages.

extra.pozn: plural only (oes = age, era); passive with cael (L11); in the book the lecture "Pŵer a Rhyw yn yr Oesoedd Canol", p. 221; own example

karty.priklad: Mae cynnig arbennig gyda ni yr wythnos hon: deg y cant oddi ar bopeth.
karty.priklad_cs: We have a special offer this week: ten per cent off everything (popeth → [b]opeth after oddi ar).

extra.pozn: phrase from Robin Radio, p. 227 (the other phrase, deg y cant, is already the card ...y cant, L7); cynnig = an offer and also the verb to offer

sever.priklad: Mae gynnon ni gynnig arbennig yr wythnos hon: deg y cant oddi ar bopeth.
sever.priklad_cs: We have a special offer this week: ten per cent off everything (cynnig → [g]ynnig as the object; popeth → [b]opeth after oddi ar).
sever.pozn: north: possession with gan (gynnon ni + soft mutation of the object) instead of gyda ni; derived from L6
